description: Fulfill the remaining quantities of an order's OPEN and IN_PROGRESS fulfillment orders with optional tracking. notifyCustomer defaults to false. Requires read_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders and write_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders (Shopify reports any other missing scope, such as for fulfillment orders assigned to a fulfillment service). Defaults to dryRun:true.

dryRun.description: True (the default) returns a before/after preview without changing anything in Shopify. Pass false to apply the change; the tool then reads the result back.

name: shopify_create_fulfillment
